about: ergo task gen (MONOREPO WT1a; docs/spec/build.md, Generators): each row is an edit of the runner some test must notice.

mutants.name: task-order-ignores-edge
mutants.rule: A generator runs after every generator whose output it reads: with every last run known, a pass runs each generator at most once.

mutants.name: task-gen-check-writes
mutants.rule: gen --check writes nothing in the tree: a generator that misses runs in a copy.

mutants.name: task-listing-unkeyed
mutants.rule: A folder a generator lists is in its key by the names it holds: a new file in it is a miss.

mutants.name: task-outputs-unchecked
mutants.rule: A hit needs the tree's outputs to hash as the stored run wrote them: a generated file edited or deleted by hand is a miss.

mutants.name: task-fresh-trusts-hits
mutants.rule: --fresh runs every generator: a stored result keyed without a file the generator reads is caught by the fresh run.

mutants.name: task-cycle-unbounded
mutants.rule: A cycle of k generators settles in k+1 running passes; one still missing after them fails naming it, never loops (only the coarse backstop would stop it, past the bound).

mutants.name: task-why-unnamed
mutants.rule: A miss names the first input whose digest moved since the last run.

mutants.name: task-last-unrooted
mutants.from: return lawcache.Key("task last", r.Root, n.Name, n.Ident)
mutants.rule: A node's last run is keyed by the tree's root: a gen in another checkout sharing the store does not make this tree miss.

mutants.name: verdict-flaky-kept
mutants.rule: A flaky verdict is never kept: the step runs again next time.

mutants.name: verdict-failure-kept
mutants.to:
case Pass, Fail:

mutants.rule: A failed verdict is never kept: a failure runs again every time.

mutants.name: verdict-affected-all
mutants.rule: --affected runs only the steps whose inputs hold a changed path.

mutants.name: verdict-why-dropped
mutants.rule: A miss always names its reason.

mutants.name: verdict-fresh-replays
mutants.rule: --fresh ignores kept verdicts: every selected step runs.

mutants.name: verdict-step-twice
mutants.to: if prev, ok := done[s.ID()]; ok && false {
mutants.rule: A step two tasks plan runs once per run.

mutants.name: child-env-inherits
mutants.rule: A child sees exactly the stated environment, nothing inherited (GATE-CHILD-ENV).

mutants.name: child-env-unnamed-passes
mutants.rule: A host variable no env line names never reaches a child nor its key.

mutants.name: child-env-key-omits-value
mutants.rule: Every entry of a child's environment is in its key, by value.

mutants.name: verdict-settle-dropped
mutants.rule: A pass is kept again over the tree as the run left it when only the run's own writes (the law ledger) moved: a second run of an unchanged tree replays every step.
